summary: Ordered transit-to-natal contacts use every transiting planet against a fixed natal planet or point, without same-moment elongation exclusions.
body: Use this policy for the app check-in layer. Same-moment aspect impossibilities do not apply here because the moving body can sweep the full zodiac against a natal placement fixed at birth.
definition: Transit-to-natal aspects are ordered contacts from a current sky body to a natal body or sensitive point.
appUsage: Use ordered keys in the form transiting_natal_aspect.
Do not apply same-moment impossibility filters to transit-to-natal lookups.
For daily check-ins, gather in-orb contacts and prioritize tightness, speed, chart relevance, and user-facing weight.
Keep outer-planet contacts contextual unless they are tight, repeated, angular, or hitting a personal planet.
note: Imported from the project policy bundle; source file was not copied into the repo.

classes.rationale: A transiting body sweeps the whole zodiac against a fixed natal point. The two are NOT co-measured, so the same-moment elongation exclusions do NOT apply. Every transiting->natal->aspect combination is valid.
classes.selection: For the daily check-in, gather all in-orb transit->natal contacts, then pick the tightest by |separation - aspectAngle|. Lane assignment (Business/Creative/Self) is downstream of selection.
classes.applyingSeparating: Compare transiting speed and direction to the aspect angle. Applying (tightening) reads as building; separating (loosening) reads as fading. Retrograde reverses the direction of approach.
cautions: Moon transits resolve in hours; treat as same-day texture, not multi-day themes.
Outer-planet transits (Saturn->Pluto) stay in orb for weeks to years; they are background, not daily weather.
Angle and node transits require an accurate birth time; degrade gracefully if time is unknown.

prohibitions: Do not filter transit-to-natal contacts through same-moment elongation impossibilities.
